none: PAS CAM-A2E797: Roman Coin : Silver siliqua of Valens, AD364-378
contea di ritrovamento: Cambridgeshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
R/ RESTITVTOR REIP ; D/ DN VALENS PF AVG

A silver siliqua of Valens, AD364-378 (Reece period 19). Reverse legend reads RESTITVTOR REIP. Reverse shows Emperor standing, holding Victory on globe and standard. Mint is Arles, AD364-367. See RIC VIII, p.63, no.6a (8). Reverse fields and exergue read: -*/OF III//CONS[T]. Obverse shows pearl-diademed, draped and cuirassed bust right. Obverse legend read DN VALENS PF AVG. Condition is fine, die…
